MathType MTEF parser vendored from https://github.com/uwjiaoxing/mathtype2omml
commit fe5293326ec047bd943de88293add86b8a9050d3 (MIT).

Only `mathtypejx/mtef` is used. Upstream LICENSE, NOTICE and font-map licenses
are retained. No Microsoft Office stylesheet is included or required.
The MathML -> OMML adapter is independently implemented in mathml_import.py.

`hyphen.tex` is the unmodified Plain TeX English hyphenation table distributed
with TeX Live. Its header permits unlimited copying and redistribution provided
the file is not modified. The original notice is retained in the file.

The renderer reads these patterns; it does not execute the TeX file. Two explicit
academic vocabulary exceptions are kept in Python, outside the original table.
No commercial fonts or manuscript data are included here.
